item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will be rather cool in the morning. The monsoon is expected to moderate slightly over the weekend, and daytime temperatures will rise over the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will be cool in the morning early next week.

Date/Month: 01/12 (Thursday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Cloudy with a few rain patches. Rather cool in the morning.
Temp range: 13 - 16 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
